explainability.note: SHAP attributions describe the model, not causal effects.

selection.rationale: Pre-specified reporting model is XGBoost (tuned on spatial CV). Its PR-AUC is within the block-bootstrap CI of the best point estimate (reported above); it is kept for the bootstrap uncertainty ensemble (fast refits) and TreeSHAP. All candidates are reported.

data_split.design: grouped spatial CV on 2 km blocks within train split; test blocks held out

scenario_curve.assumption: max1h = 25%, max3h = 50%, max6h = 70% of the 48 h total; antecedent 72 h at its median. Simulated scenario.
scenario_curve.note: unweighted logistic regression fitted on all seasons: probability that a day is a documented waterlogging day (lower bound; many events go unreported)

live_model.trained_on: ERA5 hourly (max over 9 nodes), May-Oct 2016-2026, documented event days
live_model.output: probability that the day is a documented waterlogging day (lower bound)
